source: Derived from the SunSpec Alliance information models (https://github.com/sunspec/models, json/model_<id>.json, commit 90b4a331dcca1d6eac69c1bead952fddcc5852e0, Apache License 2.0) by internal/modelgen: point names, offsets, types, sizes, scale factors, units, access, mandatory and static flags, symbol values and short labels; group names, places, lengths and counts. Offsets count from the first register after the model's ID and L (a group's points from the start of an occurrence). Modified: the symbol names of model 111's St are written without the stray "gg" prefix the source has, as in models 101 to 113; labels are trimmed.
